name: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands
wikipedia: Sovereign Principality of the United Netherlands

predecessors.name: First French Empire
predecessors.text: the Northern Netherlands, 'liberated from France by Prussian and Russian troops in 1813'

successors.name: Netherlands
successors.text: the principality plus the former Austrian Netherlands, proclaimed the United Kingdom of the Netherlands on 16 March 1815

ledger.x: 20 November 1813: the Triumvirate 'formally took control over the liberated country' and declares the principality; William Frederick lands at Scheveningen on 30 November and is proclaimed Sovereign Prince on 2 December 1813, with Amsterdam as capital.
1 August 1814: William becomes Governor-General of Belgium.

16 March 1815: William is proclaimed King William I of the United Kingdom of the Netherlands, which ends the principality (the United Kingdom page: he 'declare[d] himself king on 16 March 1815'; Brussels as the place is on the principality page only).

wars.name: War of the Sixth Coalition
wars.outcome: The French lost the Netherlands to Prussian and Russian troops in 1813 and Belgium to Allied military government in February 1814; the Treaty of Paris (30 May 1814) apportioned the left bank of the Meuse to the future Netherlands.

certainty.note: Neither page gives a boundary of the Northern Netherlands in 1813-1814; the Treaty of Paris left the Belgian right bank of the Meuse open.
